environment.description: Apollo GraphQL comment service deployed in Kubernetes namespace 'forum-backend'. Istio 1.20 sidecar injected (istio-proxy envoy). An AuthorizationPolicy resource in namespace 'forum-backend' specifies: action DENY for any request where source.namespace is NOT in ['forum-backend']. The SSR comments rendering endpoint (/posts/*/comments) is served by a separate frontend pod in namespace 'forum-frontend'. Since the AuthorizationPolicy denies cross-namespace traffic, the frontend pod in 'forum-frontend' cannot reach the GraphQL service in 'forum-backend' to fetch comments for SSR rendering. Comments are instead fetched client-side via a BFF gateway in 'forum-backend' namespace that applies DOMPurify sanitization before forwarding to the frontend WebSocket. The direct /posts/:postId/comments SSR endpoint on the GraphQL pod is unreachable from any namespace other than 'forum-backend' itself, and no pod in 'forum-backend' serves HTML to end users.

bff_gateway.sanitization: DOMPurify.sanitize() applied to comment.body before emission
bff_gateway.output: JSON over WebSocket to frontend pods

config.frontend_rendering: client-side React with dangerouslySetInnerHTML disabled, uses textContent
